kustoQueries.title: VMSS Automorphism is not running query
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: let qt = now(); let monitoredStamps = cluster('<<KUSTO_CLUSTER>>').database('wawsprod').SubscriptionHostNameMapping | where TIMESTAMP > qt - timespan(1d) and SiteName startswith "sla-ws-prod-" | summarize by EventStampName; cluster('<<KUSTO_CLUSTER>>').database('wawsprod').AntaresAdminControllerEvents | where EventStampName == Tenant and EventStampName !contains "msftint" | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) | where EventStampType =~ "stamp" and EventStampName !endswith "dr" | distinct EventStampName | join kind=leftouter (cluster('<<KUSTO_CLUSTER>>').database('wawsprod').AntaresAdminControllerEvents | where EventStampName == Tenant | where EventStampType =~ "stamp" | where EventId == 56100 | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) | summarize count() by EventStampName) on $left.EventStampName == $right.EventStampName | project EventStampName, count_ | where isnull(count_) | join kind=inner ( monitoredStamps ) on EventStampName | where EventStampName == "<<STAMP_NAME>>"

defaultHumanInterventionLoop: App Service (Web Apps)/Splinter Twin Business Hours Only
incidentProcessingGuide: Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines:,
- Run the following steps in a loop until it terminates
1. Extract the full Kusto Cluster from get_alerting_discussion_entry. eg., wawscus.kusto.windows.net, gcwsbn1ff.kusto.usgovcloudapi.net, wawscusdiagleader.centralus.kusto.windows.net

2. Run the "VMSS Automorphism is not running query" Kusto query for each stamp in the primary kusto query results detailed in the ICM incident. Replace the <<KUSTO_CLUSTER>> placeholder with the extracted Kusto Cluster and replace "<<STAMP_NAME>>" with the extracted stamp name from the ICM incident when running the Kusto query
3. Depending of if the kusto results are empty or not execute the following steps:
1. Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident with a table of the following: StampName, KustoQuery, Transient Reason
2. Provide a summary of the mitigation reason

1. Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident detailing that we will wait for a few more minutes and run the primary kusto query again to see if this issue is transient. Also post a discussion entry in the ICM incident how many times you have waiting for 10 minutes. Do this each time you have to wait 10 minutes
3. IF we waited for 10 minutes more than 5 times then TERMINATE and post a discussion entry detailing that we need the current on call engineer to do manual investgation
4. IF we waited for 10 minutes less than 5 times then LOOP back to LOOP_INSTRUCTIONS
Execute the EXECUTION_PLAN in a fully autonomous manner leveraging the tools available to you.
